desc:

title: Cliff Cooker
desc:
Blender Geometry Node Setup for Procedural Cliff Generation 

Cliff Cooker is a Geometry Nodes tool which generates cliff and rock formations from simple base meshes. By adjusting base shapes and scattered meshes, you can customize the parameters to achieve a wide variety of cliff styles.

title: Wood Works
desc:
Procedural Wood Painting Toolkit

Using an intuitive painting mode, you can effortlessly add color to models just like painting real wooden figures to perfectly match your creative vision. You can also add wooden carving to your models for added realism and create flat cutouts from 3D models. Wood Works handles all aspects of materials, textures, and UVs, allowing you to focus entirely on unleashing your creativity without any technical distractions.

title: Sporty Group Character Animation
desc:
Character rigging and animation for a mobile game at Sporty Group. I worked on 4 characters, creating around 8 animations for each.

For every character I edited and prepped the mesh for animation, built the body and facial rigs, weight painted, and animated using a mix of motion capture and hand animation in Blender, then implemented and playtested the results in Unity for mobile.

The slideshow shows examples of animations used in the game, alongside the rigs behind them.

title: Fluid Ring: Houdini Showcase (SIGGRAPH Asia 2024)
role: Environment Art, Texturing, Cinematography, Animation, Editing and Sound Design
desc:
A cinematic showcasing Houdini's fluid simulation capabilities through a ring formed of simulated water, featured at SideFX's Houdini Hive at SIGGRAPH Asia 2024. The fluid simulation was the centrepiece; I created and authored everything around it to support that goal.

Starting from the ring model, I cut away part of it in Blender, then textured it in Substance Painter with extra detail such as dirt and polished, shinier areas. I built the Unreal Engine scene from pre-made assets, added fog made in Houdini, and set up the compositions, cameras and animation. Finally, I rendered into DaVinci Resolve, edited the piece and added the sound.

title: Icelandic Riverside

title: Satoumi & Japan's Young Ocean Explorers (Anima Films)
role: Japanese–English Translation Editing, Transcription, Subtitle Timing (Freelance)
desc:
A documentary by Anima Films for Prada and National Geographic exploring "Satoumi", Japan's approach to protecting marine ecosystems by strengthening people's relationship with the sea. Benedict Cumberbatch and National Geographic Explorer Elisabetta Zavoli travel to Japan to meet ocean advocate Sakana-kun and his young exploration team.

Contracted freelance, I edited the existing Japanese–English translation for the children's dialogue in the museum experience section. I corrected mistakes in the original transcription and subtitles, and advised the team on translation and subtitle timing so the film accurately conveyed what was being said and supported its narrative.

The campaign reached 1.2M+ views on YouTube and 200M+ views across Prada's TikTok.
